nodes.description: mapping(address => bool) controllers; tracks addresses allowed to mint and burn tokens
uint256 public maxSupply; cap on total token supply, set to 40000000000 ether in initialize
public initializer that sets token name/symbol, inits Pausable/Ownable/UUPS and assigns maxSupply
public onlyController function that enforces amount + totalSupply() <= maxSupply then calls _mint
public onlyController function that destroys tokens from a given address via _burn
public onlyOwner function that pauses all token transfers
public onlyOwner function that unpauses token transfers
external onlyOwner function that overwrites the maxSupply state variable
external onlyOwner function that grants mint/burn rights to an address
external onlyOwner function that revokes mint/burn rights from an address
internal override hook guarded by whenNotPaused and chaining to super implementation
internal override restricted by onlyOwner that authorizes UUPS implementation upgrades
caller address used in onlyController and onlyOwner authorization checks and in _transfer/_approve
ERC20 _mint mutates _totalSupply and _balances and triggers _beforeTokenTransfer/_afterTokenTransfer hooks
ERC20 _burn mutates _balances and _totalSupply and triggers transfer hooks
balance/allowance arithmetic including _balances[recipient] += amount, _totalSupply -= amount and unchecked allowance subtractions
low-level target.delegatecall(data) inside ERC1967UpgradeUpgradeable._functionDelegateCall used during upgrades with attacker-influenceable newImplementation/data
external onlyProxy function that calls _authorizeUpgrade and then _upgradeToAndCallSecure on the new implementation
address to parameter of mint, destination of newly created tokens
uint256 amount parameter of mint, quantity to mint and part of the maxSupply check
address from parameter of burn, account whose tokens are destroyed
uint256 maxSupply_ parameter of setMaxSupply that is written into the maxSupply state variable
address controller parameter of addController, key written as true into controllers mapping
address newImplementation parameter of _authorizeUpgrade/upgradeTo, target of the delegatecall upgrade

edges.reason: onlyController modifier reads controllers[msg.sender], so caller identity gates the mint entry point
onlyController modifier reads controllers[msg.sender], so caller identity gates the burn entry point
onlyOwner modifier compares owner() with msg.sender before pausing
onlyOwner modifier compares owner() with msg.sender before overwriting maxSupply
onlyOwner modifier compares owner() with msg.sender before granting controller rights
onlyOwner modifier on _authorizeUpgrade restricts who may change the proxy implementation
caller reaches upgradeTo which routes through _authorizeUpgrade access control
mint reads the controllers mapping to authorize the caller before minting
mint computes amount + totalSupply() and compares it against maxSupply; unbounded amount could break the supply invariant
mint transfers execution to the ERC20 _mint routine after the supply check passes
burn reads the controllers mapping to authorize the caller before burning
burn transfers execution to the ERC20 _burn routine
addController writes true into the controllers mapping, expanding privileged addresses
removeController writes false into the controllers mapping, shrinking privileged addresses
setMaxSupply writes the owner-supplied value directly into the maxSupply state variable
initialize sets the initial maxSupply of 40000000000 ether
pausing the contract flips _paused which makes the whenNotPaused guard on _beforeTokenTransfer revert all transfers
_mint performs _totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount unchecked against overflow beyond maxSupply
_burn performs _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount inside unchecked and _totalSupply -= amount
upgradeTo invokes _authorizeUpgrade(newImplementation) before performing the upgrade
upgradeTo reaches _upgradeToAndCallSecure which performs target.delegatecall(data) with caller-supplied implementation and data, an external code execution callback path
the to parameter flows into _mint as the recipient of newly created tokens
the amount parameter flows into the maxSupply check and into _mint
the from parameter flows into _burn as the account to be destroyed from
the amount parameter flows into _burn as the destroyed quantity
the maxSupply_ parameter is assigned to the maxSupply state variable
the controller parameter is used as the key written into the controllers mapping
the controller parameter is used as the key cleared in the controllers mapping
the newImplementation parameter flows into _authorizeUpgrade and onward to the upgrade delegatecall

normalization_plan.reason: to is a temporary argument only used inside mint to address the _mint recipient
amount is a temporary argument consumed by the maxSupply check and _mint inside mint
from is a temporary argument only used inside burn to target _burn
maxSupply_ is an ephemeral argument immediately stored into the maxSupply state variable by setMaxSupply
controller is an ephemeral argument only used as a mapping key inside addController
newImplementation is a transient argument that is ultimately supplied to the upgrade delegatecall execution path
